notes.title: AMD Processors Issues
notes.content:
Hello, 

We have had a few reports from users who have AMD processors stating that the game appears to be stuttering. 

At this moment in time, we still do not know the exact cause, but would like everyone to know that we are working on this issue. 

We apologies for any inconvenience this may cause. We are working hard to try and get this fixed as soon as possible. 

Thanks 

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Fake Reviews
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As some of you may be aware, there has been accusations put forward of us creating fake reviews to boost the games rating score. 

This accusation is completely false, and we would like to stress that no person working for this company has, or ever will create fake reviews.

We respect Valve, and the digital platform they have created (Steam) on which we can sell our games to persons all around the World.

We would never want to hinder this.

Steam is part of our livelihood. Without it, we would not be able to continue making games, or to put 'food on the table'.

We have been in contact with Valve, and they have all the information that we can gather relating to this issue.

In due time, I'm sure they will post something regarding this matter.

Thank for for taking the time to read this, and in you have any further questions, please feel free to contact us at info@deceptive-games.com

Many thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Locomotion Update
notes.content:
Hi,

We have updated the locomotion system so that it now contains a strafe mechanic. 

After receiving many suggestions to implement this, we have done so. 

In addition to moving forward and backwards, you can now use the touch pad to strafe left and right. Let us know if this improves the current movement mechanics.

We are also currently implementing the teleport mechanic since some people prefer this way of movement. This will be coming soon, please be patient and check back for more information regrading this as it develops.

Any further questions, please feel free to email info@deceptive-games.com or post in the discussion forums.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Upgrade
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We have just released the VR version of this game.  

Since the original game was listed as having VR included, we are offering people an upgrade if you wish to have the VR game instead of the other 'standard' version. 

If you would upgrade from the 'standard' version to this VR version, please contact game@deceptive-games.com with some form of identification of game purchase, and we will sort this out for you. Anyone currently with both copies, we will refund the difference. 

(Please note, that VR version has no standard gamepad, mouse and keyboard support, only HTC Vive and this will only run for the remainder of the release sale).

Any questions, please email info@deceptive-games.com and we will answer them in due course. 

We apologies for any inconvenience this may cause. 

Many thanks 

Deceptive Games

notes.title: information
notes.content:
Hello, 

There have been a lot of accusations of us faking reviews. Which is totally false. No one working for us has or would do this. We know Steam's T&C's so would not do anything to jeopardise our standing on Steam since its our livelihood.

However, the damage has already been done. Reviews have changed from good to negative, and sales have plummeted. We been trying to help, and still get attacked and accused :/

For transparency. This is the email to Valve when this began:

https://www.dropbox.com/s/4hhsaevxvvnwoxv/part%20one.png?dl=0
https://www.dropbox.com/s/8qfufbrbwp4bml5/part%202.png?dl=0
https://www.dropbox.com/s/9rkcmiy3r07rcg0/part%203.png?dl=0


In addition, a few days ago we also posted an announcement offered to anyone who wanted was expecting the VR game to be in the other 'standard version' - which states about us offering a free upgrade. If you have both copies, we will refund the game. That announcement can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/games/alone/announcements/detail/608375267234808011

We wished these events of 'fake' reviews would have occurred earlier in the week so valve could have sorted this issue sooner.

But I digress. Have a nice weekend everyone.

Thanks
